limitations: Fork/live-network tests were not run. Mock Pyth inputs establish contract behavior rather than real-network oracle verification.
Passing finite bounded campaigns is not a formal proof of all economic states, actor populations, governance settings or simultaneous insolvency combinations.

Mixed accounting covers four reusable traders, two Junior LP controllers and fixed seed owners; generated opens use 17–500 lots, $0.80–$1.20 entries and $0.60–$1.40 marks; carry is 500 bps, VPI and frozen spread enabled, Junior maintenance dilution disabled.
Mixed orders commit and execute within one action; at most one pending order per trader and two LP epochs. Senior request lifecycle and general maintenance dilution are outside the mixed domain.

Mixed liquidation is Short-side negative price PnL with no trader claim or unpaid carry. Its arrears prelude repays carry before liquidation. Long liquidation and carry withheld from positive terminal gain are outside that campaign.
Mixed partial redemption funding is checked after each transition, while redemption claims wait until fully funded/refundable; generated redemptions use the controller full share wallet.
The legacy accounting ghost still observes some production reservation deltas. Preview parity and snapshot comparisons are differentiated from independent economic oracles.
Carry reference rate changes include narrower model-only examples. Standalone waterfall excludes issuance/redemption, carry, VPI, claims and raw shortage; the mixed model combines a bounded subset.
Getter fault injection, offline vector arithmetic sensitivity and isolated compiled mutations are distinct evidence classes; the report does not claim broad mutation-testing coverage.
